For local bond-antisymmetric currents j_i legal on c_i>0 and zero on c_i=0, write h=sum_i j_i=sum_A h_A eta_A. Swap invariance gives pairing -2<<h,f>>; centered-product orthogonality makes <<h,h>> a sum of squared orbit sums. Translating back to raw monomials preserves finite translation differences; these telescope against every local f. In1D j=(eta_0-eta_1)g on the environment, the map is a shape-graph incidence matrix before legality. All functions on a chosen binary patch are represented; completeness pays exponential dimension.

Define U(f)=(2chi)^-1 E sum c_i(a_i+G_i f)^2 and L(j)=(2chi)^-1 E sum(2a_i j_i-j_i^2/c_i), with zero quotient on forbidden transitions. Exact orbit cancellation gives U-L=(2chi)^-1 E sum_{c_i>0}[c_i(a_i+G_i f)-j_i]^2/c_i, hence L<=D<=U. This is familiar variational duality with an exact constructive admissibility test, not invention of the Dirichlet/Thomson principles. The no-go applies to bounded finite-range, translation-covariant legal antisymmetric currents when vacancies initially confined to any finite rectangle cannot make their first legal jump outside (box closure). Orbit cancellation telescopes pointwise for configurations filled outside a box. Multiplying finite configuration-flow conservation by particle first moment and averaging product measure gives zero interior displacement pairing. Fixed-width boundary terms vanish after division by volume, yielding E_p[(eta_0-eta_ek)j_k]=0 and L(j)<=0 in every direction at every patch size. The source applies this to square-lattice k=2 Kob-Andersen dynamics, not the successful1D benchmark. Imported positivity of its variational diffusivity then separates full admissible currents from the energy closure of exact local kernels. The cited hydrodynamic result uses zero softening; this does not assert a hard-constraint hydrodynamic theorem for arbitrary initial states or that cooperative diffusion is zero.

The different missing operation is a local legal current j_R with a certified admissible nonlocal completion J and ||J-j_R||_{c^-1}<=epsilon_R, where ||v||^2=E sum_{c_i>0}v_i^2/c_i. Then D>=L(j_R)-[2||ca-j_R||epsilon_R+epsilon_R^2]/(2chi). The inequality is conditional on acquired legality, orthogonality and the energy-error bound. No affordable completion, routing congestion or tail certificate for cooperative Kob-Andersen was constructed. Epsilon_R is not supplied by a guessed gap, small boundary error or name for an unbounded routing method. Softening forbidden rates gives an upper comparison, not a lower certificate for the original target.
